name: Norms: metanorms and the mutation rate (Galán & Izquierdo Fig. 7)
description: Galán & Izquierdo's Fig. 7: the metanorms game at lower and higher mutation rates; the metric is the share of runs collapsed. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-26): after 10 000 generations 0.8, 0.9, 0 and 0 at mutation 0.001, 0.003, 0.01 and 0.03 (after 1 000: 0, 0.1, 0, 0). Lower mutation lets the vengefulness of an unchallenged population drift away, so the norm collapses — as they found.
